gen-gf-offside-archivo: Offside draws pen-like lines of constant weight and spreads them wide, with curves that stubbornly refuse to close up. Archivo, a plain sans, turns its curves outward and stands tall beneath.
gen-dafont-starborn-manrope: Manrope keeps every curved letter bright at its mouth, with barely any step from capitals down to lowercase. Starborn, by contrast, scatters wide gaps between its letters and lays a thick dark stripe of lowercase through each line.
gen-dafont-nulshock-fs-asap: Asap reads with open arcs on its c and a body height that nearly matches the capitals. Nulshock goes the other way, stretching out with spacious tracking and an unshaded outline that never wavers.
gen-dafont-origami-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans makes words look sturdy and large, with tall lowercase and an e whose eye opens clearly to the right. Origami's brush-like single stroke gives it a sharp contrast, so try the heading bigger.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads in curvy, unclamped letters with a tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascender tips, all on a wire-like monoline skeleton. Plakkaat's closed, heavy forms meet that openness head on.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-fira-sans: Quantum spaces its letters loosely, keeping its mouths open and its ascenders compressed into a tidy, technical line. Fira Sans, a plain sans, adds a larger x-height and wide-ended s curves beneath.
gen-dafont-stencilia-general-sans: Stencilia is structural and striking, with spacious gaps at its curve terminals and a compact step up to the ascenders. General Sans follows with a smooth, unobstructed path around each bend.
gen-dafont-stentiga-manrope: Spread-out and luxurious, Stentiga opens its tracking wide and gives crossbars the heft of its stems. Manrope, a clean sans, would look lost if the heading were made small.
gen-gf-oxanium-archivo: Oxanium brings a high x-height and uninterrupted monoline strokes that make its lowercase look big and commanding. Archivo does the quieter work, opening its curves outward for a sans that stays approachable.
gen-dafont-woodgod-satoshi: Commanding and a little vintage, Woodgod lets a wide channel run into every bowl while its lowercase nearly reaches the capitals. Satoshi, a sans-serif with a soaring x-height, keeps every stroke at one width beneath.
